The '''Good Neighbor of the Year award''' was an award [[Standard year/Legends|annually]] given out by the [[Coruscant Benevolent Society]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Due to his helpful nature, the [[Kedorzhan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Dewell Bronk]] earned the award three times while he lived on Coruscant.<ref name="Inc" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Good Neighbor of the Year award was mentioned in the short story "[[Incognito]]," which was published in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine's [[Star Wars Insider 143|143rd issue]]<ref name="Inc" /> on [[July 23]], [[2013]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/143|text=''Star Wars Insider'' 143}}</ref> The story was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] as a tie in to his novel [[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']].<ref name="Inc" />
